subject: Error in deploying Shinyapp - Maximum supported R version is: 3.1.3

messages.author: 934ba4c9bdc7db9f
messages.subject: Error in deploying Shinyapp - Maximum supported R version is: 3.1.3
parts:
I recently updated my R and it is version 3.2.0. I built my app on this version. The app works fine locally. But when I tried to deploy it, I get this error:

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 27463188 failed: Error parsing manifest: Maximum supported R version is: 3.1.3

What can I do to get around this? I need to deploy the app before the end of the week.

I know the team is working on adding support for R3.2.0 by the end of the week, but if the timing is close, I would downgrade to R 3.1.3 for now.
-Tareef
